item.title: Chat Completions: max_tokens renamed
item.description: For newer models, the Chat Completions parameter max_tokens has been renamed to max_completion_tokens. Update openai.chat.completions.create calls accordingly. Legacy models still accept max_tokens.

item.title: gpt-4-0613 deprecation notice
item.description: Model gpt-4-0613 will shut down on 2026-10-23. Migrate to gpt-4o.
